craft_notes: Sthāyin: no-beyond (common things EVEN — api again: the low places included). Rows: row 2 (everywhere→going). Close: going (gati — nondual GOING: motion-verb as state). Rejected: 'immanent' — killed: everywhere kept (the distributive, not the doctrine-word); 'nothing lies beyond' declarative — killed: not-beyond kept flat (na param as fragment).

lines: Everywhere Bhairava-state, in common things even:
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvatra bhairavo bhāvaḥ sāmānyeṣv api gocaraḥ | na ca tadvyatirekteṇa paro 'stīty advayā gatiḥ

reads_against.argmap: Where is Bhairava-state? → Bhairava-state is immanent everywhere — nothing beyond it, nondual.
c1_essence: Bhairava everywhere in common things: nondual, no beyond.
